figurative_meaning_en: Swearing a solemn oath holding Ganga water
similar_in_english: Cross my heart and hope to die
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি গঙ্গাজলে শপথ করে বললেন যে কখনো মিথ্যা বলবেন না।
এই বিষয়ে গঙ্গাজল নিয়ে শপথ করো, তাহলে বিশ্বাস করব।
example_sentences_in_english: He swore on the Ganga water that he would never lie.
Swear on the Ganga water about this, then I'll believe you.
history: The idiom draws from the Hindu tradition where Ganga water is considered sacred and purifying, often used in rituals and oaths to invoke truth and divine witness.
note: The original text 'গঙ্গাজলি৩' appears to contain a typographical error or annotation; cleaned to standard 'গঙ্গাজল' based on context.
